1: // Nebula Escape – minimal canvas game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   // ----- Audio -----
7:   const thrustSound = new Audio('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/johnnyreilly/audio-assets/thrust.wav');
8:   const collisionSound = new Audio('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/johnnyreilly/audio-assets/collision.wav');
9:   const gameOverSound = new Audio('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/johnnyreilly/audio-assets/gameover.wav');
10:   // reduce volume
11:   thrustSound.volume = 0.2;
12:   collisionSound.volume = 0.3;
13:   gameOverSound.volume = 0.5;
14:   if (!canvas) {
15:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
16:     return;
17:   }
18:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
19:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
20:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
21: 
22:   // ----- Visuals -----
23:   const stars = [];
24:   for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
25:     stars.push({
26:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
27:       y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
28:       radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
29:     });
30:   }
31: 
32:   function drawBackground() {
33:     // dark space gradient
34:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
35:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#00102a');
36:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#000814');
37:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
38:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
39:     // stars
40:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
41:     for (const s of stars) {
42:       ctx.beginPath();
43:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
44:       ctx.fill();
45:     }
46:   }
47: 
48:   // ----- Game entities -----
49:   const ship = {
50:     x: canvas.width / 2,
51:     y: canvas.height / 2,
52:     angle: 0, // radians
53:     radius: 10,
54:     speed: 0,
55:     thrust: 0.2,
56:     friction: 0.98,
57:     shield: 100,
58:   };
59: 
60:   const asteroids = [];
61:   const maxAsteroids = 30;
62: 
63:   function spawnAsteroid() {
64:     const side = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
65:     let x, y, vx, vy;
66:     const size = 15 + Math.random() * 25;
67:     const speed = 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.0;
68:     // spawn at edges
69:     if (side === 0) { x = 0; y = Math.random() * canvas.height; vx = speed; vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed; }
70:     else if (side === 1) { x = canvas.width; y = Math.random() * canvas.height; vx = -speed; vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed; }
71:     else if (side === 2) { x = Math.random() * canvas.width; y = 0; vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed; vy = speed; }
72:     else { x = Math.random() * canvas.width; y = canvas.height; vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed; vy = -speed; }
73:     const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
74:     const rotationSpeed = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02; // slow spin
75:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, radius: size, angle, rotationSpeed });
76:   }
77: 
78:   // ----- Input handling -----
79:   const keys = {};
80:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = true; });
81:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });
82: 
83:   function updateShip() {
84:     // Rotation
85:     if (keys['arrowleft'] || keys['a']) ship.angle -= 0.05;
86:     if (keys['arrowright'] || keys['d']) ship.angle += 0.05;
87:     // Thrust
88:     if (keys['arrowup'] || keys['w']) {
89:       ship.speed += ship.thrust;
90:       // play thrust sound
91:       if (thrustSound.paused) {
92:         thrustSound.currentTime = 0;
93:         thrustSound.play();
94:       } else {
95:         thrustSound.currentTime = 0;
96:       }
97:     } else {
98:       // stop thrust sound when not accelerating
99:       thrustSound.pause();
100:       thrustSound.currentTime = 0;
101:     }
102:     // Apply velocity
103:     ship.x += Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.speed;
104:     ship.y += Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.speed;
105:     ship.speed *= ship.friction;
106:     // Wrap around edges
107:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x += canvas.width;
108:     if (ship.x > canvas.width) ship.x -= canvas.width;
109:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y += canvas.height;
110:     if (ship.y > canvas.height) ship.y -= canvas.height;
111:   }
112: 
113:   function updateAsteroids() {
114:     // Move, rotate and recycle
115:     for (const a of asteroids) {
116:       a.x += a.vx;
117:       a.y += a.vy;
118:       // update rotation
119:       if (a.rotationSpeed) a.angle += a.rotationSpeed;
120:       if (a.x < -a.radius) a.x = canvas.width + a.radius;
121:       if (a.x > canvas.width + a.radius) a.x = -a.radius;
122:       if (a.y < -a.radius) a.y = canvas.height + a.radius;
123:       if (a.y > canvas.height + a.radius) a.y = -a.radius;
124:     }
125:     // Remove old and spawn new
126:     while (asteroids.length > maxAsteroids) asteroids.shift();
127:     if (asteroids.length < maxAsteroids && Math.random() < 0.02) spawnAsteroid();
128:   }
129: 
130:   function checkCollisions() {
131:     for (const a of asteroids) {
132:       const dx = ship.x - a.x;
133:       const dy = ship.y - a.y;
134:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
135:       if (dist < ship.radius + a.radius) {
136:         ship.shield -= 20;
137:         // play collision sound
138:         collisionSound.currentTime = 0;
139:         collisionSound.play();
140:         // bounce asteroid away
141:         a.vx *= -0.5; a.vy *= -0.5;
142:         if (ship.shield <= 0) {
143:           // Game over – stop loop
144:           cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
145:           // play game over sound
146:           gameOverSound.play();
147:           alert('Game Over!');
148:         }
149:       }
150:     }
151:   }
152: 
153:   function draw() {
154:     // Draw space background first
155:     drawBackground();
156:     // Ship – draw with thrust flame
157:     ctx.save();
158:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
159:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
160:     // ship body
161:     ctx.beginPath();
162:     ctx.moveTo(15, 0);
163:     ctx.lineTo(-10, -8);
164:     ctx.lineTo(-10, 8);
165:     ctx.closePath();
166:     ctx.fillStyle = '#00f9ff'; // cyan ship
167:     ctx.fill();
168:     // thrust flame when accelerating
169:     if (keys['arrowup'] || keys['w']) {
170:       ctx.save();
171:       ctx.beginPath();
172:       ctx.moveTo(-10, -5);
173:       ctx.lineTo(-18, 0);
174:       ctx.lineTo(-10, 5);
175:       ctx.closePath();
176:       ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
177:       ctx.shadowColor = 'orange';
178:       ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
179:       ctx.fill();
180:       ctx.restore();
181:     }
182:     ctx.restore();
183:     // Asteroids – draw with rotation and shading
184:     for (const a of asteroids) {
185:       ctx.save();
186:       ctx.translate(a.x, a.y);
187:       ctx.rotate(a.angle);
188:       // create radial gradient for depth
189:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, a.radius * 0.2, 0, 0, a.radius);
190:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#777');
191:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#222');
192:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
193:       ctx.beginPath();
194:       ctx.moveTo(a.radius, 0);
195:       ctx.lineTo(a.radius * 0.6, a.radius * 0.8);
196:       ctx.lineTo(-a.radius * 0.6, a.radius * 0.8);
197:       ctx.lineTo(-a.radius, 0);
198:       ctx.lineTo(-a.radius * 0.6, -a.radius * 0.8);
199:       ctx.lineTo(a.radius * 0.6, -a.radius * 0.8);
200:       ctx.closePath();
201:       ctx.fill();
202:       ctx.restore();
203:     }
204:     // Shield bar
205:     ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
206:     ctx.fillRect(10, 10, 100, 8);
207:     ctx.fillStyle = 'lime';
208:     ctx.fillRect(10, 10, ship.shield, 8);
209:   }
210: 
211:   let animId;
212:   function loop() {
213:     updateShip();
214:     updateAsteroids();
215:     checkCollisions();
216:     draw();
217:     animId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
218:   }
219: 
220:   // Start game
221:   loop();
222: })();

(End of file - total 222 lines)
